lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign), home (new_flow), and choose_path (reorder) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed after noise correction (+7.8% vs -6.3%).
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, backed by 3 positive noise-corrected tests including 1 win (+8.1%), though no clear effect was seen in the other 2 tests.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, but were too low for the round 8 sign_in reorder test.

candidates.title: Pet Choice Split Comparison Stage
candidates.change: Redesign the pet choice screen using a split layout to clearly present pre-made companion selection versus custom generation side-by-side.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate at 60.9% and a long mean duration of 1017s, indicating visual hesitation and confusion during adoption.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a ready-to-adopt companion or upload photos to craft your own.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pick_friend screen layout inside onboarding is allowed and preserves its core job.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop-off (39.1%), but redesign tests have weak historical support.

candidates.title: Post Companion Selection Sign-In Reorder
candidates.change: Move sign-in directly after companion selection so users pick their pet before creating or logging into an account.
candidates.why: Reordering sign-in steps previously yielded positive noise-corrected results (+8.1%), and asking for sign-in after picking a companion increases user intent.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in within onboarding is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in reordering is well-supported by 3 positive previous tests including an 8.1% win.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Render Status Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen after waiting to explicitly confirm desktop render readiness and visual asset generation before entering home.
candidates.why: Support logs show multiple complaints about pets failing to appear on desktop or app stalling, alongside a high mean home wait duration of 2336s.

new_desktop_readiness.headline: Preparing Desktop Companion
new_desktop_readiness.body: Rendering pet visuals and checking system desktop integration...

guard.reason: Adding a new readiness screen inside onboarding before home intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail evidence, but adding new screens often slows conversion.

candidates.title: Pet Control Mode Setup Flow
candidates.change: Add an interaction choice component on the final screen allowing users to pick how they prefer to interact with their pet on desktop.
candidates.why: Support reported 3 emails regarding confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Choose Preferred Companion Mode
home_intro.body: Select how your pet behaves on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Adding an interaction choice component to the home intro screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support complaints, but new flows on finish step have weak evidence.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Status Progress Tips
candidates.change: Show progress indicators and detailed progress tips during pet generation on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has an extremely high mean time of 2336s, causing user drop-off due to perceived stalling.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Unique Pet
waiting.body: Our engine is building custom animations and behaviors.

guard.reason: Adding real wait progress indicators and tips to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High mean wait time (2336s); cheap copy/info update to reduce bounce during wait.

candidates.title: Path Selection Mode Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Provide a helpful hint on path selection explaining that chosen preferences can be changed later in app settings.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean duration of 514s compared to a median of 8s, indicating user friction over path commitment.

choose_path.hint: Don't worry—you can adjust your path or switch modes anytime in settings.

guard.reason: Adding guidance hints to the choose_path screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high mean duration (514s vs median 8s) via low-cost hint copy update.

candidates.title: Background Processing Desktop Alert
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification alerts when companion rendering completes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: With a mean waiting time of 2336s (over 38 minutes), users minimize the app and need notification when generation finishes.

waiting.body: You can minimize this window. We will alert you when your pet lands on your desktop!

guard.reason: Enabling completion notification alerts on the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Helps long 38-minute render wait, re-engaging users when background processing finishes.

candidates.title: Companion Trait Choice Reward Badge
candidates.change: Display a dynamic trait verification badge on the adoption certificate screen celebrating pet registration.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest funnel conversion (60.9%); providing a sense of achievement encourages completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your companion is officially registered with special starter personality traits!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions rewards/free extras ('special starter personality traits').

candidates.title: Account Sync Reassurance Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize that signing in backs up pet data and prevents companion resets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Save & Protect Your Desktop Pet
sign_in.body: Sign in to back up your pet data safely and prevent companion reset across sessions.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to explain data protection without dark patterns or rule violations is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Backed by 8 support emails; simple, low-cost copy change with low risk.

candidates.title: Two Column Path Selection Layout
candidates.change: Switch the choose path screen to a two-column layout for clearer side-by-side comparison of onboarding paths.
candidates.why: Choose path mean time is 514s, showing that users spend significant time comparing long path options.

guard.reason: Redesigning choose_path with a two-column layout is allowed and preserves choice options.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long comparison time on path step, but choose_path changes have thin evidence.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign), home (new_flow), and choose_path (reorder) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed after noise correction (+7.7% vs -6.2%).
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, backed by 4 positive noise-corrected tests including 1 win (+8.0%), though no clear effect was seen in the other 3 tests.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, but were too low for the round 8 sign_in reorder test.
